subject: RETURN statement
notes: kb/Work PB337, LANDED. The RETURN twin of SR-14.9.30.3-2, split the same way: the COUNT -- 'there shall be exactly one record area subordinate to the SD for file-name-1' -- is CheckIntoReceiver's (COBOL1995), and the second sentence, 'This record area shall be a strongly-typed group item of the same type as identifier-1', is CheckStrongMove's over the implicit move's sender (COBOL1533, kb/Work PB348). The count difference from READ's rule 2 is the rules row's AdmitsRecordLessEntry and nothing else: 'exactly one' here, 'at most one ... if specified' there, because an SD shall carry a record description and an FD need not. PRE-FIX MEASUREMENT: the note's probe shape is now caught by PB348's COBOL1533 -- a different rule -- while the count obligation had no check; an SD with two record areas and a strongly-typed identifier-1 now draws COBOL1995 at 2002, 2014 and 2023. EDITIONS: 2002 and up -- the TYPEDEF/TYPE facility is absent from ANSI X3.23-1985, so the rule is unreachable at 85 by construction and no gate is written for it. retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Compiler/Binding/Validation/StatementValidation.cs#CheckStrongMove (kb/Work PB878 deleted StatementValidation.CheckStrongMove; the RETURN INTO implicit move's same-type check is MoveTable16.StrongGroupRefusal, framed by MoveBinder.MoveCategoryLegality)
